ValidationRule.description: Prevents changes to PHOCS Regulatory Code Violation records once Status is Resolved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSRegulatoryCodeViolation", NOT(ISNEW()), NOT($Permission.EHISBypassValidationRuleCustomPermission), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Retracted"), NOT(ISCHANGED(Status)), NOT(ISCHANGED(DateResolved)) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Retracted"), ISCHANGED(Status) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Violation record cannot be edited once the status is marked as Retracted.
